$comment: Your controlled vocabulary. 'build' refuses any source/medium not listed here, so analytics never splinters into linkedin / LinkedIn / li. Campaigns are validated as lowercase kebab-case; add a 'campaigns' array only if you want a closed list instead. 'defaultMediumForSource' lets you omit --medium for the common case. 'lint' scans the files under scanDirs for links to urlHost that forgot their tags or carry values outside this vocabulary. Copy to utm.vocab.json and edit (set scanDirs to your own content directories). examples/content/ deliberately contains tagged, untagged, and wrongly-tagged links so the lint demo has something to catch.
